Course Description
This seminar focuses on report writing of research, group study, and training of students' research ability.

Course Goals
1.	To introduce students to the research methodology.
2.	To help students familiarize themselves with journal paper for specific topic.
3.	To make discussion on report writing of research
schedule:
Week 1~2 Research methodology introduction
Week 3~4 Group study for journal paper for specific topic.
Week 5~18 Discussion on report writing of research
assessment:
Attendance and class performance 30%
Group discussion 30%
Term work 40%
